## Questions of interest

1.  Is the number of upper-division PSTAT courses taken associated with students' self-reported statistics comfort?
2.  Do students who have taken both PSTAT 131 and PSTAT 134 report greater interest in machine-learning-related fields than students who have taken PSTAT 131 only?
